title: 第1039章 贾昂的暗中布置第1038章 贾昂的三头堵
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 邢军说道：“倒也是，感觉禁地出来的人，好像现在都呆呆的，不像是之前那些人了。”
贾昂说道：“当然，之前的人，是需要出来做事的，有担当的，自从天策楼开始后，
禁地就没有出过什么像样的人，当时我让禁地的人，去和墨灵斗的时候，一个都没有成功的，
如果不是最后我出手，他们早就没有了。”
邢军说道：“说起墨灵来，好久没有见过他了？”
贾昂说道：“他出去执行任务了，只是不知道去哪里了。”
邢军说道：“这对你来说，也是好事，不用直接面对他。”
贾昂耸了耸肩，说道：“也还好，我倒是没有什么感觉，还是看他自己能不能想明白吧。”
邢军说道：“这有什么想不明白的，现在都没有圆桌会了，他还有什么想要闹的，再说了，
他是三人小组的人，本身和我们就没有什么可比性了，还要闹什么？”
贾昂说道：“这谁知道，不过，我确实不想见他，他那个人，脑子真的不正常，看着平常没有什么变化，
但是一遇到我，就和失了智了一样，这个事情，还是要让他们去解决，我是解决不了。”
芦斌说道：“不管怎么说，你至少在常青阁里，他不在，之后的地位还是比他高。”
邢军说道：“我看未必，常青阁的人，是由三人小组定了，如果墨灵回来，他肯定会进来的，
只是他现在不在，所以才安排了别人。”
贾昂说道：“这个无所谓，反正也不是我一个不喜欢他，安亮和薛英柏也不喜欢，所以，
我不用去理会，他的存在，是三人小组要考虑的事情，不是我，再者说了，他在哪，又不会对我们有什么直接的影响，
除非他出面直接阻止我，要不然，我不会有任何的影响。”
邢军说道：“那我们就先走了，等之后我们再说这些事情。”
贾昂点了点头，随后便说道：“好，你们自己考虑就好了，我就不多说什么了，你们要尽快，
找到我来说的那些事情，不要让他们再找到我们的错处，将主动权抓在我们手中。”
两人点了点头，随后便都离开了。
两人离开后，贾昂身后走出一人，说道：“你打算利用他们？”
贾昂说道：“不算是利用，只是想要他们帮我做些事情，分散一下他们的注意力，柳文都亲自来了，
自然不能不给他们面子，总要走走过场吧。”
那人说道：“霍安那边，你有把握吗？当时是你要杀他，现在又要他和我们合作，
不太现实。”
贾昂说道：“我只是让你去问问，不是真的想要和他合作，我又不知道他身后的人，到底是谁，
如果贸然合作，可能会有风险，只是探探口风。”
那人说道：“那要是他问了，怎么办？”
贾昂说道：“你不是有那边人的身份，用那个就行，现在没有人注意到你，已经消失了。”
那人说道：“好，我只打了，我会尽快处理这件事，只是我还需要些配合。”
贾昂说道：“你说，你想要什么？”
那人说道：“需要一些真实感。”
content_en:
Xing Jun said: "That's true, I feel that the people who came out of the forbidden area seem to be in a daze now. They are not like the people before."
Jia Ang said: "Of course, people in the past need to come out to do things and be responsible. Since the beginning of Tiance Tower,
There was no decent person in the forbidden area. When I asked the people in the forbidden area to fight Mo Ling, none of them succeeded.
If I hadn't taken action in the end, they would have been gone. "
Xing Jun said: "Speaking of Mo Ling, haven't you seen him for a long time?"
Ja Ang said: "He went out to perform a mission, but I don't know where he went."
Xing Jun said: "This is also a good thing for you, as you don't have to face him directly."
Jia Ang shrugged and said: "It's okay, I don't feel anything. It's up to him to figure it out."
Xing Jun said: "What's not clear about this? There is no round table meeting now. What else does he want to cause trouble? Besides,
He is a member of a three-person team, so there is no comparison with us, so why bother? "
Jia Ang said: "Who knows, but I really don't want to see him. His mind is really abnormal. He doesn't seem to have changed much.
But when they meet me, they feel as if they have lost their minds. They still have to solve this problem. I can't solve it. "
Lu Bin said: "No matter what, at least you are in Changqing Pavilion. If he is not here, your status will still be higher than him."
Xing Jun said: "I don't think so. The people in Changqing Pavilion are decided by a three-person team. If Mo Ling comes back, he will definitely come in.
It's just that he's not here right now, so he arranged for someone else. "
Jia Ang said: "It doesn't matter. Anyway, I'm not the only one who doesn't like him. An Liang and Xue Yingbai don't like him either, so,
I don't need to pay attention to it. His existence is something that the three-person team needs to consider, not me. Besides, where he is, it won't have any direct impact on us.
Unless he directly stops me, I won't have any influence. "
Xing Jun said: "Then let's leave first, and we will talk about these things later."
Jia Ang nodded, and then said: "Okay, you can just think about it yourself, I won't say anything more, you have to hurry up,
Find the things I'm talking about, don't let them find fault with us anymore, and take the initiative into our hands. "
The two nodded and then left.
After the two left, a man walked out from behind Jia Ang and said, "Are you going to use them?"
Jia Ang said: "It's not a use, I just want them to do something for me to distract their attention. Liu Wendu came in person.
Naturally, we have to give them face and just go through the motions. "
The man said: "Huo An, are you sure? You wanted to kill him then, and now you want him to cooperate with us.
Not very realistic. "
Jia Ang said: "I just asked you to ask. I don't really want to cooperate with him. I don't know who the person behind him is.
If we cooperate rashly, there may be risks. We are just testing the waters. "
The man said: "Then what if he asks?"
Jia Ang said: "You don't have the identity of someone over there, just use that. No one notices you now, you have disappeared."
The man said: "Okay, I just fought. I will deal with this matter as soon as possible, but I still need some cooperation."
Jia Ang said: "Tell me, what do you want?"
The man said: "Need some realism."
